title: LAN BUBBLE — eat through every gate. Eliminate ports. There are only π-ports.
summary: Pause and look local. Every computer gate: eat through eastGate, eat through sporeGate, eat through everything on the localized network. Wired or wireless within the land bubble. Use LAN and WAN, ethernet, intranet as the subsystem. From inside-outside-in-in-between. ELIMINATE ALL PORTS. No 3000. No 8080. Only π-ports.

pi_ports.the_rule: ELIMINATE ALL PORTS. There is no 3000. There is no 8080. There are only π-ports.
pi_ports.what_this_means: Ports are arbitrary numbers chosen by humans. They should be mapped to π positions on the circle.

mapping.principle: Each service = a position on the unit circle, measured in radians from 0 to 2π

80.position: just past midnight — the web, the first light

443.position: early morning — encrypted web, still dark

25.position: midnight — SMTP, mail in the dark

pi_ports.on_the_globe: Each π-port is a position on the equator ring. Services rendered as dots at their radian position.
pi_ports.the_insight: Ports are just angles on a circle. 65536 positions on 2π radians. The circle IS the port space.
